svg.title: NVCA model cache architecture
svg.desc: The control plane sends a launch specification with a cache handle. The NVCA agent resolves the cache StorageClass, the capability catalog ConfigMap and the live CSIDriver into a persisted selection, elects one writer Job that downloads the artifacts from NGC onto a shared claim or writer volume, and the admission webhook mounts that data read-only into every function pod across namespaces. Storage backends are selected by catalog data, not by code.
svg.text: One writer per cache handle, read-only readers in every namespace, backend chosen from catalog data
